description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results for two Text-to-SQL methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total” in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks shown from about 20 up to 60 at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category displays a grouped pair of vertical bars: NatSQL is shown in a light blue bar and TA-SQL in a darker blue bar, with numeric values annotated above each bar. For “Simple,” NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14; for “Moderate,” NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; for “Challenging,” NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and for “Total,” NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are not presented as sorted by value; they follow the category order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color legend and the value labels.
